items.canonical_title: Human learning is an understudied but promising lever for boosting human–AI synergy
Effects of structured generative AI feedback on data science students' critical thinking: a propensity score matching approach
From dyad to triad: human–AI collaboration and the changing roles of teachers and learners in formal education

notes: Window November 20–27; catch-up to September 21. Consensus searches across R1–R9, two rate limits retried; selected items sourced independently from publisher or institutional version of record. Frontier monitoring included CHM, Rahwan, Brinkmann, Baumann, Derex, Oudeyer and Microsoft Tools for Thought.
Berger: study-level feedback contrast uncertain and not randomized; Yin: two intact classes and residual confounding; Conrad: theoretical only.
Excluded Dewi and Fitri November 25 because abstract and body report materially inconsistent ANCOVA statistics; accepted-only Frontiers abstracts excluded pending publication date.
